groups.title: Groups
groups.name: Name
groups.new.help: The callsign is derived from the group’s key, so there is nothing to choose and nothing to collide with. The name is only a label, shown once the signature checks out.
groups.mint_failed: Could not mint a group — no profile is open.
groups.empty:
No groups yet.

There is no directory to search: a group reaches this station when somebody in earshot mentions it, or when you create one.
groups.known: {n} known. There is no directory — these are the groups you hold a key to, plus every group this station has heard a signed act for.
groups.forget.title: Forget {name}?
groups.forget.mine:
This drops the group’s KEY from this device. The key cannot be regenerated — the callsign is derived from it — so you could never sign for {call} again, and anybody else who heard its record still has it.

The group does not stop existing. Only this device forgets.
groups.forget.other:
This device forgets {call}: its roster and the signed acts it kept.

The group does not stop existing, and you will hear about it again if somebody in earshot mentions it.
groups.candidates.empty: Nobody is waiting. A grant only becomes membership when the person signs an acceptance, so anyone invited appears here until they do.
groups.header.admin: You hold this group’s key, so you are its admin. The key cannot be rotated — the callsign is derived from it.
groups.header.member: The group signs its own decisions. Yours are signed by you.
groups.unverified: This group’s announcement has not arrived, so nothing below can be checked. It is shown anyway rather than shown as empty — a group you cannot verify must look unverified, not look like it has no members.
groups.invited.title: You have been invited
groups.invited.body: Being named in a grant is not membership. Joining is a signed act by you, naming this invitation ({offer}) — and so is leaving, which is why nobody can claim you joined or deny you left.
groups.candidate.desc: Invited as offer {offer} — waiting for them to accept
groups.invite.title: Invite to {group}
groups.invite.label: Callsign
groups.invite.help: They are not a member until they accept. Until then they show as a candidate, here and on every station that hears this.
groups.forget.detail.mine: This drops the group’s KEY from this device. It cannot be regenerated — the callsign is derived from it — so you could never sign for this group again. It does not stop existing: everybody who heard its record still holds it.
groups.forget.detail.other: This device forgets the group’s roster and the signed acts it kept. The group does not stop existing, and you will hear of it again if somebody in earshot mentions it.
groups.muted.title: Muted accounts
groups.muted.empty:
Nobody is muted.

Mute an account from the ⋯ menu on any of its posts. Its posts stop being shown — and stop being stored.
groups.muted.count: {n} muted. Each key is muted on its own — a name and an avatar are free to copy, an account key is not.
